pending_manual_reviews.instruction: Confirm that the source argument, author position, and useful examples remain continuous.

Review the entire assembled draft, including claims introduced by the writer, for materially false or invented facts. Classify conflicts using source-integration-pass-v1.md and do not edit the draft. Record level 1 while owner calibration is active and always record level 2; pass means the review is complete and no level 3 conflict remains.
